title: "4.8 Monitoring plan"
order: 8

## What is monitored

Each new cohort of applicants is compared with the development sample (the training split,
[4.2](data.qmd#split-and-seed)), and, once its outcomes are known, measured against the
model's development performance. The thresholds are policy constants, kept in one place
(`wiki/facts/policy.py`) and printed here by name.

| Metric | Population | Threshold | Frequency | Action on breach |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Score PSI, by band | new applicants vs training split | below {{< var monitoring.psi_watch >}} stable; {{< var monitoring.psi_watch >}} to {{< var monitoring.psi_act >}} watch; above {{< var monitoring.psi_act >}} act | every cohort | Watch: find the features that moved. Act: review with the validator; recalibrate or redevelop. |
| Feature PSI, over the scorecard's bins | new applicants vs training split | same as the score | every cohort | A feature above {{< var monitoring.psi_act >}}: check the source data before the model. |
| Observed / predicted default rate, by band | booked loans with outcomes | ratio outside {{< var monitoring.ratio_lo >}} to {{< var monitoring.ratio_hi >}} | when outcomes mature | Check the band's default count first; a breach that persists into the next cohort triggers recalibration. |
| AUC, all applicants | the cohort's applicants with outcomes | below the gate, {{< var score.gate >}} | when outcomes mature | Gate breach: redevelopment ([4.9](gate.qmd)). |
| AUC, booked only | the cohort's booked loans with outcomes | a fall of more than {{< var score.auc_ci_half >}} from development ({{< var score.pop.booked.auc >}}) | when outcomes mature | Review with the validator; weigh gating on the booked population (finding 2). |

The last row is the control for finding 2 ([4.7](limitations.qmd)): the booked-only AUC is
always reported beside the gate, never instead of it. The PSI rows are the control for
finding 1. The fall that triggers review on the booked AUC is the half-width of the
all-applicant bootstrap interval ([4.5](performance.qmd#discrimination)); the booked
population is smaller, so its own interval would be wider, and the threshold is
deliberately the stricter of the two.

## Development baselines

What "no change" looks like, measured at development. The calibration baselines are on the
held-out **booked** applicants, the same population the calibration check monitors
([4.5](performance.qmd#held-out-booked-applicants)).

| Metric | Development value | Population |
|---|---|---|
| Score PSI, by band | {{< var score.psi_score >}} | train vs held-out applicants |
| Largest feature PSI | {{< var score.psi_max >}} ({{< var score.psi_max_feature >}}) | train vs held-out applicants |
| AUC | {{< var score.auc_holdout >}} | held-out applicants |
| AUC, booked only | {{< var score.pop.booked.auc >}} | held-out booked applicants |

| Band | Observed / predicted | Defaults behind it | Population |
|---|---|---|---|
| D | {{< var score.band_booked.D.ratio >}} | {{< var score.band_booked.D.defaults >}} | held-out booked applicants |
| C | {{< var score.band_booked.C.ratio >}} | {{< var score.band_booked.C.defaults >}} | held-out booked applicants |
| B | {{< var score.band_booked.B.ratio >}} | {{< var score.band_booked.B.defaults >}} | held-out booked applicants |
| A | {{< var score.band_booked.A.ratio >}} | {{< var score.band_booked.A.defaults >}} | held-out booked applicants |
| AAA | {{< var score.band_booked.AAA.ratio >}} | {{< var score.band_booked.AAA.defaults >}} | held-out booked applicants |

Bands B, A and AAA are already outside the calibration tolerance at development, each on
few defaults ([4.5](performance.qmd#held-out-booked-applicants)). The first cohorts with
matured outcomes show whether that is noise or a persistent under-prediction at the safe
end; until then, a breach in those bands is read against its default count before any
action.

## Redevelopment triggers

Any one of these starts a redevelopment, with the validator informed:

1. The all-applicant AUC on a cohort with outcomes falls below the gate.
2. Score PSI above {{< var monitoring.psi_act >}}.
3. A band's observed / predicted ratio outside the tolerance in two consecutive cohorts.
4. A change to any input's definition or source, including the bureau feed
   ([4.6](sensitivity.qmd#bureau-feed-down-a-gate-failure-documented)).

A redevelopment is also where findings 3, 4 and 5 and the observations in
[4.7](limitations.qmd) are acted on.
Every redevelopment re-runs [4.5](performance.qmd) and [4.6](sensitivity.qmd), passes the
gate, and forces the downstream work in [D3](../d3-dependencies.qmd#what-a-scorecard-change-forces).

## What is automated today

This plan is documented, not yet automated. The platform has one cohort of applicants, so
there is no new population to compare. What runs today is the development side: `python
verify.py` recomputes the held-out AUC against the gate, and every figure on this page,
from the committed model and data on every run ([D9](../d9-implementation.qmd)).
